title: Funded expert-review-hours engagement (hard budget cap)
context: Content tasks (M2 onwards) require sign-off from a credentialed public-finance or governmental-accounting expert before any explainer ships. Volunteer expert time may not always be available; this funded task covers a metered expert-review-hours engagement under a hard budget cap, using donor escrow funds via the Hee-Lee Oss funded lane. Reviewer independence must be preserved: the expert holds a veto on content accuracy and fairness, and must recuse from jurisdictions where they have a material financial or political interest. This is a future backlog item for when volunteer review is unavailable.
objective: Engage a credentialed public-finance or governmental-accounting expert reviewer under a funded, hard-budget-capped arrangement via the Hee-Lee Oss funded lane to provide snapshot-scoped sign-off on pilot jurisdiction budget and contracts explainer content.
acceptanceCriteria: Engagement conducted under the Hee-Lee Oss funded lane with a hard budget cap (fundedBudgetUsd) that is never exceeded
Reviewer is a credentialed public-finance professional, governmental accountant, or public-administration academic; credentials recorded in the reviewers ledger
Reviewer independence preserved: no material financial or political interest in the reviewed jurisdiction; COI declaration recorded
Expert sign-off scoped to the specific dataset snapshot and checksum reviewed; does not carry forward to new snapshots
Name-use limited to versions the expert approved; no implied endorsement of unreviewed content
Outcome documented: which content was reviewed, expert sign-off recorded, any required corrections logged
output: A document recording the funded expert review engagement: reviewer credentials, COI declaration, scope (snapshot and checksum), sign-off or required corrections, and cost ledger entry within the hard budget cap.
